LESSON: ULUL-AZM PROPHETS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: General
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.2: Ulul-Azm Prophets
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Ulul-Azm Prophets, part of Pillars of Iman in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 General.

Key inquiry question: Why are the Ulul-Azm Prophets important to Muslims?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. research on the qualities of Ulul-Azm Prophets and present on charts/power point,

2. watch or listen to video clips on/read the stories of Nabii Musa (A.S.) and Issa (A.S.) and make notes,

3. narrate the stories of Nabii Musa (A.S.) and Issa (A.S.) and make notes.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. research on the qualities of Ulul-Azm Prophets and present on charts/power point,
2. watch or listen to video clips on/read the stories of Nabii Musa (A.S.) and Issa (A.S.) and make notes,
3. narrate the stories of Nabii Musa (A.S.) and Issa (A.S.) and make notes.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Ulul-Azm Prophets together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy: The skill of interacting with digital devices is heightened when learners research on the qualities of

Ulul-Azm Prophets and present them on PowerPoint.

• Self-efficacy: The skill of effective communication is enhanced when they narrate the stories of Nabii Musa (A.S.)

and Issa (A.S.).

• Creativity and imagination: the skill of making observations is enhanced when learners dramatise the stories of

Nabii Musa (A.S.) and Issa (A.S.).

Values:
● Social Justice is enhanced as learners narrate stories of Nabii Musa (A.S.) and Issa (A.S.).

● Responsibility is enhanced as learners research on the qualities of Ulul-Azm Prophets and present them on

charts/PowerPoint.
